objective: Repair the reported major Bominal regression by replacing the thin Evidence Spine/Object Graph/Copilot strip with a dense, cohesive, visually interactive operational intelligence console.

bominal_patterns_reviewed: /tmp/bominal-ref/app-bizos.jsx command center, logic catalog, workflow detail, and cost/health density

gap_analysis.source: runtime screenshot inspection against Bominal corporate/workflow references after the user's regression report
findings_addressed: The previous Evidence Spine was only four sparse cards and did not communicate Bominal-grade feature density or object-lineage depth.
Operational intelligence, object graph, evidence ledger, and governed copilot were visually separate concepts instead of one cohesive command product.
Evidence filtering, object-node selection, and copilot route actions were not visually functional enough to satisfy the 'fully interactive and functional, just not wired' constraint.
Native hidden semantics were being overridden by dense component display classes, so filtered rows could still measure as visible in browser QA.

implemented: Replaced the sparse operator-intelligence card row with a full Evidence Spine/Object Graph operational intelligence console in the hydrated Leptos view.
Mirrored the same console in the SSR static render so the Bominal-grade surface exists before hydration and remains selective-island friendly.
Added a five-metric KPI strip, evidence search, evidence state filters, six evidence ledger rows with owner/source/SLA metadata, and selected-row visual state.
Added an eight-node selectable object graph linking Tenant, Workflow, Approval, Mail, Messenger, Community, Cloud cell, and Receipt with sidepeek metadata.

Added a governed Copilot rail with audit, workflow, mail, and community route actions plus a cross-module signal lineage board that ties Workflow to built-in Messenger/Mail/Community/Cloud/Audit surfaces.
Added local JavaScript for evidence filtering/search/actions, object-node selection/status, copilot route actions, Activity Center events, and #evidence-spine/#object-graph deep links.
Added Bominal-style low-radius, dense table/ledger/toolbar/object-graph CSS and restored global [hidden] semantics so filtered rows really disappear in the browser.

observations: SSR output contains evidence-intelligence-console, five evidence filters, eight data-object-node controls, and eight data-intel-action controls

verification.command: Playwright smoke for #evidence-spine, evidence filters/search/open, object-node selection, Workflow route, Mail route, console/network health

observations.blockingStatus: 1 visible · blocking state · local evidence only
observations.objectStatus: Workflow selected · side peek and lineage ready

verification.command: pixelmatch secondary debug diffs against Bominal corporate and workflow-studio 1440px references cropped to shared viewport

visual_verdict.category_match: Bominal-style operational command center plus evidence/object graph/cadence intelligence, integrated into the Oyatie shell
visual_verdict.verdict: The repaired slice now has Bominal-grade density: an evidence ledger, selectable object graph, governed copilot actions, lineage board, filters, search, sidepeek inspection, and cross-suite routes. It reads as one product surface rather than unrelated panels and addresses the largest visible feature-depth regression in the prior mockup.
improved_matches: The console uses Bominal's flat, tactical, dense information architecture instead of generic AI cards.
Evidence, workflow, mail, messenger, community, cloud ops, and audit are connected in one visible lineage.
Controls are visually functional: filters hide rows, object nodes select, copilot buttons route to Workflow/Mail/Community/Audit, and Activity Center events are staged locally.
SSR and selective hydration both carry the surface, preserving the product's current rendering architecture.
remaining_differences: No real evidence, approval, workflow, mail, community, or audit backend is wired; this is still a local visual prototype.
Bominal's full product has additional modal/detail drilldowns and typed APIs beyond this repaired slice.
The broader complete mockup objective still has more depth to add across remaining modules, so the active goal is not being marked complete.

non_claims: No backend workflow execution, evidence write, mail send, community post, audit commit, entitlement change, or cloud action occurs.
All actions are browser-local visual state and route previews only.
This changes one high-impact regression slice and does not claim the full dashboard/mockup is complete.
